column1: # target: national form entries that have a PokeAPI pokemon_id (1025 defaults + 326 alternatives)

# source: EXTERNAL/PROBABLE, not from the game files: PokeAPI data/v2/csv (commit 5ee47a9a9c1229632ec4b473a9c1c53026e005dd, fetched 2026-10-17; BSD-3-Clause) + Pokemon Showdown (MIT, commit 7244fe8e28fa8bc4d0809ae30d183c608b62bb2b) for the Legends: Z-A learnsets. For species/forms with active rows in data/pml_personal.tsv the VERIFIED game sheets always win at load time (crates/pla/src/national.rs).

# semantics: equivalence table pokemon_id <-> national_number + form_index; form_index 0 is the default form, the rest are numbered by pokemon id; form_kind: base|regional|mega|gmax|form (DERIVED); height_dm = decimetres, weight_hg = hectograms; name_en/name_es from pokemon_form_names (fallback: pokemon/species name); base_experience 0 means PokeAPI publishes no value for that row (recent Z-A megas).
